items.text: Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️
We’ve released a new update focusing on stability fixes, controller improvements, balance adjustments, and gameplay enhancements. Here’s everything included in this patch
Fixed an issue where the Golden Eagle achievement could trigger twice, granting the reward twice
Fixed a rare issue where NPCs would not stand up and leave after a Sermon following an Expedition
Fixed a bug where urns were incorrectly consumed while packaging at the Delivery Station (urns should not be consumed during packaging)
Fixed an issue where the Delivery Station courier could fail to arrive, pick up only part of the available boxes, or not return for the remaining deliveries
Fixed an issue where delivery boxes sometimes would not spawn until the game was reloaded
Fixed reports of zombies getting stuck behind trees during Expeditions
Fixed an issue where zombies could get stuck behind certain objects and stop attacking
Fixed a rare issue where Stamina could save at 0 and never regenerate
Fixed a critical save-breaking issue where a broken grave could prevent the game from progressing to the next night
Fixed a critical save-breaking issue after returning from an Expedition that could completely lock the game (inventory not opening and game loop not progressing)
Fixed an issue where turrets placed during Expeditions would not return to the inventory afterward

Fixed a critical issue where the dog could permanently fail to spawn if the naming panel closed unexpectedly (for example when night starts), preventing players from naming the dog after unlocking the Dog House
Fixed controller sensitivity in Expeditions not being affected by sensitivity multipliers
Fixed an issue where interacting with Storage while holding a box using a controller would delete the item instead of storing it
Fixed an issue where moving items between Storage and Backpack could break input due to selected object loss
Fixed a similar input issue in BioSell App and Auction App when selling items
Improved turret target detection (more consistent behavior in large-scale scenarios)
Added an additional validation check for the Golden Eagle achievement after loading the game
Added Night Brightness setting
Zombie waves now continue scaling after reaching the level cap.
From Level 10 onward, tougher and more varied zombie waves will begin to appear
Added new interactions for the Dog House: Call the dog back to the house & rename your dog
Adjusted Antique item drop rates
Rebalanced Dog House unlock cost
Rebalanced Research Lab unlock cost
Rebalanced prices and profits across multiple items to improve overall economy flow
As always, thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!
Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️
With this update, we’re officially moving from v1.5 to Version 2.0, completing the roadmap we’ve been working toward for a long time!
Some features were released earlier as part of our Christmas Update, and this update focuses on what’s new and what completes the picture, here’s what’s new:

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/190fe448dc1c47cbd31d720cbb22da7051714eb7.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/9ec6d2d24026205cd9905fd1d10ddec8657b0a5a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/11a2b81c1011e550cc8ec54779de8c75adc6a29b.png"]
You’re no longer alone during the night.
By unlocking the Dog House, you can now get a Pet Companion to help you defend your graveyard at night
Your dog roams around during the day and actively assists you during nightly zombie waves
You can choose from a list of random names, or give your companion a name of your own!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/2b97d20a4988aa0fe8761c46ec9c319e55c7478c.png"]
Desert Eagle – a powerful new handgun with high stopping power
Secret Weapon – a special variant waiting for players who complete all achievements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/532e33cd469aba6cd7b9311a3a1626beda68254f.png"]
Zombie Graveyard Simulator is now officially Steam Deck Playable.
The game runs out of the box on Steam Deck with minimal setup
Performance has been significantly improved
Previously, heavy combat and night waves could drop to 10–25 FPS
Now, gameplay runs at a stable 60 FPS, even during intense moments
The reason for Playable (instead of Verified) is that some UI text can appear smaller on Steam Deck, especially in certain languages
Overall readability and controls are solid, and UI improvements are planned for the future
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a8837df1b64c221e9edf2af3da5f8e89f370eeb5.png"]

notes.title: The game now supports three additional languages

items.text: Hungarian
Norwegian
Kazakh
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/127f184734602055dc5df0c7c75a671b1ac1d6ac.png"]
This update includes the largest optimization pass we’ve ever done. We focused on making the overall experience smoother, more stable, and more enjoyable across all hardware setups
CPU & Gameplay Systems
Many CPU-heavy systems were rewritten or optimized
Turret logic was heavily optimized, especially in late-game scenarios
Large, fully built graveyards now perform significantly better
Inventory & Storage
Inventory and Storage systems were completely reworked
Previous stutters and frame drops when moving large amounts of items are gone
Item transfers are now smooth and instant
GPU & Rendering
Major GPU-side optimizations in rendering and occlusion culling
Zombie ragdolls optimized
Improved shadow distance and grass draw distance handling
Fixed a critical issue causing the UI to refresh every time you fired a weapon
Graphics Settings Improvements
Low, Medium, and High presets now have clear visual and performance differences
Fully disable Shadows
Fully disable Volumetric Lighting
Ambient Occlusion now has a real performance impact when disabled
Engine Update
The game has been upgraded to Unity 6.2
Updated the number of Planter Areas gained through upgrades
Fixed an issue where zombies wouldn’t attack vehicle during Expedition vehicle defense missions
Fixed a rare bug where corpses could get stuck in the player’s hands while carrying
Fixed a rare issue where urns could break while being carried by employees
Rebalanced prices and profits across multiple products and systems to improve overall economy flow
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/4e48e5bc948242addb940edaf9268a4fb5adc2d9.png"]
With Version 2.0, the original roadmap for Zombie Graveyard Simulator is now complete.
For now, we don’t have a new content roadmap locked in. We’ll be taking some time to evaluate what comes next, based on player interest, long-term demand, and the future direction of the project.
This also means that features discussed in the past, such as co-op, are not currently planned, but we’re intentionally keeping the door open.
We’re also working on a new project, so you can expect a new announcement from us soon!
Regardless of future content decisions, bug fixes, stability improvements, and critical updates will continue as needed.
As always, thank you for your support, feedback, bug reports, and patience.
Reaching Version 2.0 wouldn’t have been possible without the community behind the game.

topNew: Desert Eagle – a powerful new handgun with high stopping power
Secret Weapon – a special variant waiting for players who complete all achievements

items.text: Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️🎄

We’re wrapping up the year with a special New Year Update! Some of the features you’ll see in this update were originally planned for Version 2.0, but as a small New Year gift, we wanted to bring a portion of them forward so you can enjoy them earlier.

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/fddc06435309c2f3e3ad3bdbc55807eedae2a044.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/046139841a76f9809cec90c1df154ba7207db657.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/27af6c2a7d49ef7d00f206d035413090471fb404.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/cc5fec9e5b9f008b139522a1fb6272cb684998ec.png"]
The graveyard is ready to celebrate the holidays!
The entire graveyard is now decorated with Christmas themed visuals
Festive lights, decorations, and even a ginger cookie house can be found around the map
A cozy seasonal atmosphere to enjoy while managing your graveyard
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/127f184734602055dc5df0c7c75a671b1ac1d6ac.png"]
We’re actively working on a large-scale optimization update planned for Version 2.0.
While full details will be shared in the next update notes, you can already expect improvements in this update such as:
More stable frame times
Reduced performance spikes
Noticeable FPS improvements
Additional graphics settings
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/99284f4b2fa9334f9fe95e31a6f8c090ba71faab.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/88dc67ab37726bfa1fa037c39fa6f556de607f44.png"]
You can now craft multiple items at the same time on Stone Workshop and the Research Lab
Improved layout and scaling for resolutions other than 16:9 (such as 16:10 an widescreens)
General usability and control improvements
Antique items can now be delivered to families instead of only being sold via the Auction App
Backpack capacity increased
Added rotating function to Stone Wall Corner, allowing more modular wall construction
Added an additional category filter for Auction items
Updated ammo consumption for Tesla and Flamethrower Turrets
These turrets now consume significantly less ammunition
Example: previously 1 propane tank per shot, now 1 propane tank per 4 shots
DLSS and FSR have been temporarily disabled, but don't worry they will return with Version 2.0
Multiple CPU and GPU optimizations have been applied
Fixed an issue where auto-fire weapons could jam while firing
Fixed an issue where footstep sounds did not properly switch between grass, stone, and other terrain types
As always, thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!

topNew: The graveyard is ready to celebrate the holidays!
The entire graveyard is now decorated with Christmas themed visuals
Festive lights, decorations, and even a ginger cookie house can be found around the map

items.text: Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️
This update introduces a brand-new Research Lab and Upgradeable Barricades, giving you more ways to turn zombies into profit and to hold the line when night falls!

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/af3e8f452d0d4e2414750c8a85af620f911cdfe3.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/3688e6a73172f30e1154b58164ede8de18090315.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/05d63edc630f12fe74379799f996920a9879fbcd.png"]
Dead zombies aren’t going to waste anymore. They’re now part of your production line!
Zombies that die during the night are now collected and stored in the Research Lab morgue
From there, you can move them to the Resurrection Table and bring them back as controlled test subjects
Revived zombies can be placed into special cages, and each zombie type generates unique special resources over time
You can unlock multiple cages to speed up your resource production and build a proper bio-factory
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/0d8e97cf5716db816ebcf576ef33de63eb55a6e2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/b6c1bbb7ada71dc1eb91d1448241168930a653e6.png"]
Sold directly at base value
Or processed at the Lab crafting station into items like Gore Bait, Red Serum, or valuables like Alpha Cure for much higher profit
All bio products can be sold through the new BioSell App on your computer, so you can manage the whole process from storage to sale in one place
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/3c716ca4b34f763e39362150a77bc80eb52ba8d5.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/0e5406e736ca45eb12237584232fd406657a7974.png"]
Your defenses are no longer just throwaway planks.
Barricades can now be upgraded through 3 tiers
Each tier increases health and durability, making them last much longer against stronger waves
You can transform a basic wooden board into a reinforced plank, and eventually into a sturdy metal barricade
This gives you more control over how you build your defenses: light and cheap, or heavy and long-lasting
Fixed an issue where ammo items duplicated when they were left on the ground and the game was reloaded
Fixed a bug where cleaning stains in the Chapel caused the player to lose energy instead of the employee
Adjusted seed prices for better economic balance and progression
Fixed an issue at the Urn Station that caused all urns in the same category to be consumed
Fixed a bug where the courier sometimes failed to arrive at the Delivery Station
Fixed an issue where employees were not loading correctly when entering the game
Localization improvements and text fixes across multiple languages
As always, we’re continuing to work through your feedback, bug reports, and suggestions to make Zombie Graveyard Simulator smoother, deeper, and more fun to manage and defend.
Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️
This update includes new systems such as the Stone Quarry & Workshop, Auction App & Antiques, as well as new Halloween decorations and a long list of fixes and improvements!
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/e65ee3feb707c85864a8e7f9a976cabc47147696.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/73afbda44bcd1253208b7a8cc99bb82ee17f2f99.png"]
Your graveyard is expanding once again with new production and crafting systems!
The Stone Quarry & Workshop can now be unlocked like other stations.
Once active, it introduces a mining machine that allows you to extract four types of stone: Limestone, Sandstone, Slate, and Granite.
At first, it only mines a single type in small quantities, but upgrading the station increases both the stone variety and yield multiplier.
The Stone Workshop lets you craft gravestones using the mined materials.
A unique gravestone type exclusive to this workshop has also been added, offering significantly higher income.
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/76bb80210aa007557711dc9839b4e620547cba7e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/46a7fb0ecb046f1fcc604b17d9e0031aa5fb2f5b.png"]
Turn rare finds into profit with the brand-new Fast Auction App!
There’s now a chance for corpses (after burial or cremation) to drop antique items such as journals, pocket watches, gold-plated clocks, or even diamond rings!
These antiques can be listed for sale through the Auction App on your computer.
You’ll receive bids from potential buyers and once sold, you can collect your earnings directly from the app.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/597a38088324b088f3fffc355a8e2f6a11f3f6a5.png"]
The Upgrade interface has been redesigned for clarity and ease of use:
Tabs have been moved to the left side for better readability.
Hovering over a locked tab now displays a page with message explaining why it’s locked.
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/33e124fdba45787ed1c3366cd6e097297b86a1bb.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/f0717d0d12d7b1d251a1587e81026a207cca2c54.png"]
Bring a spooky atmosphere to your graveyard with new seasonal items!
Pumpkin Lights
Cauldron
Spooky Fence
Broom
Economy balancing: Seed prices have been reduced to increase profit margins, and some upgrade costs have been adjusted for better progression.

Defense item rework: Prices, durability, and damage output have been improved, especially for barbed wire, wooden & chain fences, electric surface, spiky wooden fence and stone walls, which now deal noticeably higher damage.
Fixed a bug where food items with buffs did not restore health or energy when eaten.
Localization updates and translation improvements across multiple languages.
Fixed an issue where if an employee was carrying a corpse when exiting the game or starting an Expedition, the body would now correctly return to the nearest morgue instead of dropping to the ground.
Fixed visual and system issues when an employee unclogged a toilet, it now correctly updates and functions after interaction.
Fixed employee position errors when unclogging toilets.
Fixed a bug causing the Delivery Guy to spawn twice after loading the game.
Fixed Urn locking and missing box spawn issues at the Delivery Station.
Fixed a bug causing Urns inside delivery boxes to spawn outside after returning from Expeditions.
Fixed an issue where visitors would not wait for sermons after saving and loading mid-sermon.
Fixed a bug preventing sermons from starting if the player went on an Expedition while visitors were waiting.
Fixed Management App not listing all graves correctly in the population tab.
Fixed an issue where the Urn at the Delivery Station could disappear at the start of packaging.
Improved loading stability and performance, loading sequences are now smoother and less likely to freeze.
Thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!
Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️
We’ve just released a small patch addressing several bugs, balancing issues, and a few quality-of-life improvements.
Technician can now unclog toilets for you!
Engine update applied to patch the recently discovered Unity security issue affecting all games using Unity game engine.
Added a Level × Reward multiplier for Expeditions. As you progress, missions will become more challenging but offer higher rewards.
Overall Expedition difficulty balancing adjustments for smoother progression.
Fixed an issue where the “Check Funeral Offers” objective could reappear after returning from an Expedition.
Fixed a bug causing two Delivery Guys to spawn after Expedition.
Fixed an issue where the Urn could slide to an incorrect position at the Packaging Station.
Fixed a bug that allowed leaving the Packaging Station before the packaging process was complete.
Fixed a bug at the Custom Urn Station where pressing the Back button (Right Mouse Button on PC) could break the urn-filling process.
Fixed an issue where the Tank zombie’s stun effect could persist if the night ended while you were disoriented.
Fixed a bug preventing the “Fully Staffed” achievement from unlocking.
Fixed an issue where the “Personal Touch” achievement wouldn’t trigger when first opening the Custom Urn Station.
Thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!
Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️
This update brings one of the biggest changes in Phase 3, introducing the brand-new Expeditions Mode along with new enemies, weapons, achievements, and plenty of fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Here’s everything new in this update

items.text: 🧭 Expedition Station
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/d71ed7503770d3d603d198780168aed1053f81a2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/2b567dcf1b01a260fa6501c28ea59957ca02bb06.png"]
Your graveyard now features the Expedition Station, a radio station that lets you answer distress calls and venture outside the graveyard for the first time!
Unlock the station to gain access to the Expedition App, available on any computer.
Answer distress calls coming through the radio, these are randomized missions waiting for your response.
Like other stations, the Expedition Station includes its own upgrade panel:
Extended Radio Range to increase mission frequency
Enhanced Radio Frequency to unlock new mission types
Completing upgrades makes the system more dynamic, offering a steady flow of different missions as you progress.

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/e1abef57e3ad44f6e196dd209edd5ad667a6d313.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/aa33aaaae65cd4a378efe78223f724523af76cef.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/d20904660c032dfcf46021e79cb551258162b353.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/48c6a20cca1ec30f061e43b47228c56322d6f9e2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/5821b9826607efa294a487e26b5411f3a9087896.png"]
Expeditions take you beyond your graveyard into fresh new environments and missions, each with unique challenges. These missions can include, for example:
Defending an airdrop from incoming zombie waves
Helping a stranded vehicle stuck on the road
Protecting a family home or farm under siege
Each mission is randomized, keeping every expedition fresh. Completing them rewards you with money and XP, while station upgrades increase mission variety and frequency as you progress.
🔫 New Weapons
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/0f11c34ebe9aff8da19a9290ba2c5496732152f5.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/130b25b7b6d4c0c0b5990cb15595ab50ddaee2c2.png"]
P90 SMG: A compact, fast-firing weapon with a large magazine, equipped with a flashlight for night vision and a suppressor for stealthier zombie kills.
T-20 Rifle: Our strongest full-auto rifle yet, featuring a custom grip that significantly reduces recoil.
A new nightmare joins the roster!
Large and bulky, but surprisingly fast.
On death, it explodes with acid that causes temporary disorientation: blurred vision, muffled sounds, and dizziness.
Tough to kill and extremely dangerous up close
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a6e804bfcf98403b4f6ccb8eddb90d0d66939329.png"]
40 new achievements added, doubling the total from 40 to 80!
New goals include station objectives, financial milestones, sales, expeditions, and more.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth="689"][td colwidth="689"]
⚠️ Some achievements may not unlock when you load your latest save file, as they rely on data that was not tracked in earlier save files.

However, you can still continue playing with your old save and there is no need to start a new game. For those specific achievements, you’ll simply need to perform the required actions again in your current save to unlock them.
Improved weapon handling: camera shake, aiming positions, and overall feel have been polished.
Localization updates and corrections across multiple languages.
Reduced clogging chance for toilets.
Fixed an issue where the Confessional could be used before being unlocked.
Fixed a bug where sermon cooldown increased after unlocking the final Chapel upgrade.
Reduced the height of the Stone Wall to improve turret line of sight
Fixed an issue where Urn Pickup objectives would not appear if Urn is on the ground
Thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!

topNew: Unlock the station to gain access to the Expedition App, available on any computer.

items.text: Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️
This update marks the completion of Phase 2 of our roadmap, bringing exciting new chapel upgrades, employees, languages, and a terrifying new blood moon event!

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/dad7bcaebc18101fa720b7f4126274f539797e25.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/c40bc2de131750694a57d7bba119b710a743689b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/90fa751ee500b2f80218cfd8224117df58f1020e.png"]
Priest, Pianist, and Custodian are now available to hire!
Sermon Altar: Prepare 3-sentence sermons in a mini-game. The quality of your words affects morale and boosts Chapel donations. If you hire a Priest, he can handle sermons automatically!
Piano: Hire a Pianist to play calming music for extra morale and increased donations
Confessional Booth: With a Priest, visitors will line up for confession, and the Priest will step in to listen

Chapel Cleaning & Maintenance: As more visitors attend, the Chapel will get dirty and candles will burn out. You can also perform all these tasks manually, but with a Custodian, the cleaning, candle-lighting and restocking of the Souvenir Shop can be automated.
Chapel Upgrade Tree: unlock Sermon Altar, Piano, Confessional, Faster Sermon Cooldown, and more by delivering successful sermons
New storage added inside the Souvenir Shop for faster access
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a26921f65f6f62299bc1dd5ed7dc31a60939bb30.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/27c3a4fbf458766f3d881808a4c152d84143d9e6.gif"]
Visitors now have a place to take care of their needs
Toilets charge a small fee per use
After repeated use, toilets can clog, fix them with a plunger!
You can unlock up to 2 stalls
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/2a26c84e366d418ea6469c2c86726162e26c28d0.gif"]
🗳️ This weapon was chosen based on community feedback and polls!
A new powerful Melee Weapon that deals much more damage than a shovel
Unlockable at Level 7
On certain nights after leveling up, a Blood Moon may occur
The sky and moon turn red, and zombies become much stronger and more aggressive
Blood Moon can be toggled on/off in the settings
You can now reach level 10 and unlock new items, station upgrades, and more customization as you grow your graveyard empire!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a8837df1b64c221e9edf2af3da5f8e89f370eeb5.png"]
🗳️ All four languages were selected based on community feedback and polls!
Portuguese (Brazil)
Dutch
Swedish
Ukrainian
Employees now keep their positions on Quick Save and after loading, they will appear exactly where they were last saved instead of respawning from the door
Added attack sound effects for both Axe and Shovel
Performance optimizations and minor fixes
📌 With Phase 2 now complete, we’re already working hard on what’s next!
Thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!

topNew: Priest, Pianist, and Custodian are now available to hire!
Piano: Hire a Pianist to play calming music for extra morale and increased donations
Confessional Booth: With a Priest, visitors will line up for confession, and the Priest will step in to listen

items.text: Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️
This update brings new weather effects to enhance the atmosphere, plus a brand new Zombie Waves modifier for those who want a completely different gameplay experience!
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a72011f79500f033b04c521f8792f52e9769d5ea.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a385c69c78202f6bbb1744573c47c7c451ab74d0.gif"]
Clear – Classic & sunny skies with a bright atmosphere
Foggy – Low visibility for an eerie graveyard feel
Heavy Rain – Stormy downpours to set the scene
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/3a88025a167e5c577b1667ac348d2ccd5b0bf786.png"]
Added a Zombie Waves toggle in Game Modifiers that lets you completely disable night zombie waves.
This means you can now play from start to finish without encountering zombies at all!

⚠ Important Note: This is an experimental setting and goes against the game’s intended balance. With no zombie waves, you won’t lose graves and progression will be much easier. Defense costs will also be completely removed since you don't need them.
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/93fe231e0de2b36da4dbbaf8665d8d42d34d945c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/b06ee5b97046f0f737b8221d0237674e21869e70.png"]
Souvenir Shop visual redesign now has a more store-like appearance with new glass walls, sliding door, tile, lamps!
Added spending and winnings limits to Blackjack
Removed the reward for running out of money in Blackjack
Fixed several logic issues in Blackjack
Fixed an exploit where quitting mid-game avoided losing money
Employees are now listed under their work area instead of just by job type
Increased hiring limit of Gravekeepers and Technicians from 2 to 4 in total
Removed zombie entrances unlocked with Graveyard Expansion 2 to allow for a more balanced defense layout
Fixed an issue where starting a new game didn’t trigger the tutorial in rare occasions
Updated Delivery Guy appearance (new Outfit and Hat)
Fixed an issue where leaving the Custom Urn Station mid-filling could cause errors
Fixed a issue where Delivery Only urns didn’t complete the "Urn Ready" task after successful delivery
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a8837df1b64c221e9edf2af3da5f8e89f370eeb5.png"]
The new languages planned for Phase 1 have now been moved to the Phase 2 major update due to localization work in the upcoming update. This is where we need your help!
We’ve prepared a list of potential languages based on player demand and community size, but we can’t add them all at once.
Head over to our Discord server and check the #dev-updates where you can vote for which 3 languages should be added first. Join the poll and help us decide which languages will come to the game next!
Thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!
Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️
This update is part of our ongoing work to complete Phase 1 of the roadmap and bringing key new features, cremation upgrades, and the first community-voted weapon!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/97b6b934c5fd54051ea7a16dd0429ed9d136addc.gif"]
5 new Urn variations added
Bodies may now request Specific Urn Types as special requests
Use the Custom Urn Station to transfer ashes into the correct urn to fulfill these requests
Higher-quality urns = higher payouts!

Some urns are now marked as Delivery Only
Use the Delivery Station to pack ashes and place them in delivery boxes
A courier will arrive at scheduled times to pick up the packages
Delivery orders provide even greater money!
A new upgrade panel for the Crematorium has been added (Old one was re-labeled as Furnaces)
Unlock and improve the new Custom Urn and Delivery systems through this panel
You can now reach level 9 and unlock new items, station upgrades, and more customization as you grow your graveyard empire!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/6ed0f6b4d90b180a0725839e964c5dd27e6bcfb6.gif"]
Take a break and play Blackjack using in-game money

Over the past few weeks, we’ve hosted a series of community polls on Discord to decide which weapons should be added to the game next. Hundreds of players voted, and the first winner is finally here!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/71710140906f50e7baf85142f3dfc140cdfeb6d3.gif"]
A powerful light machine gun with a high fire rate and large magazine and perfect for mowing down hordes of zombies during late-night waves.
But that’s just the beginning!
This is the first of five new weapons selected by our community. Here’s the full lineup coming in future updates:
P90 SMG – Compact, fast, and ideal for close quarters
Desert Eagle – Heavy pistol with serious stopping power
Axe – Our first melee weapon for up-close action
Type 20 Rifle – Reliable, balanced long-range option
🛠 Bug Fixes & Improvements
Urns now display cause of death and additional info
DLSS and FSR can no longer be enabled at the same time (fixed related bugs)
Fixed zombie difficulty not updating properly when switching Relaxed Mode
Fixed bug where dragging urns too quickly could cause them to become invisible
Fixed an issue where the cremation progress bar could get stuck at 99%
Fixed crematorium effects not appearing after certain save/load scenarios
Fixed occasional sound overlap when multiple actions triggered at once
Fixed UI scale issue when opening Management App on ultra-wide monitors
📌 We’re getting closer to completing Phase 1, but there’s still more to come!
Thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!
Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️

Today’s update brings highly-requested features, quality-of-life improvements, and important bug fixes. We heard your feedback loud and clear, Quick Save was requested frequently, so we moved it up in our plans to get it to you sooner!
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/e41a33768061b4cf61d5ee0ae8f92c0ce7838699.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/15f211b783f371f0c0f22a3d1ea85791826c9e67.png"]

notes.title: A big new tool to track your progress

items.text: [carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/cbed922cdee1c84e12adbc94b30a8119fbe40eee.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a8dc7bdaabbd8541a439579f456b1acc803608b1.png"]
Track visitor trends to see what’s popular and what's not.
View visitor counts for the last 10 days and visitor activities from the last 5 days.
Check detailed statistics on your income.
See a complete list of all buried bodies, including how much money you've earned from each grave.
Note: The Management App begins tracking data after this update! Previous progress won’t appear.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/23150d3810d3fb24977eff52b3f531557a4fdada.png"]
Relaxed Mode is now a preset of custom modifiers! You can now change & tune the game to your liking:
New Zombie Waves difficulty settings: Relaxed, Easy, Normal, Hard
Toggle Longer Days (On/Off).
Toggle Energy System (On/Off). Disabling this means actions won’t require energy!
Toggle Preparation Phase (On/Off). Previously always active in Relaxed Mode.
Note: You don't need to start a new game to change the options, you can change them in the settings menu. Just make sure to check if the settings are correct after the update!
Your actions now directly impact your graveyard’s popularity:
Doing things right grants points, mistakes lower your score.
Your reputation determines visitor likelihood and affects your overall success.
Added AMD FSR support for improved performance and visuals.
Optimized GPU usage to reduce overall load.
Improved optimization to minimize FPS spikes.
Better scaling for Quality Presets (Low, Medium, High now clearer and more consistent).
Added Camera Smoothing option in Settings for smoother camera motion (ideal for controllers).
Fixed controller not working on some panels (like Game Over) — now fully functional.
Added Steam Deck button prompts for Steam Deck players.
Re-mapped default controller buttons: Pause button now opens Pause Menu, Back button opens Inventory.
Improved damage value for R500 Revolver and DMR-14 Rifle.
Fixed Fertilizer Machine bug where compost boxes couldn’t be picked up after saving/loading.
Fixed early payment calculation error in the loan system.
Fixed an issue where money and item notifications could get stuck on screen.
Fixed localization issues in French and German, along with general translation fixes.
Fixed a bug that allowed graves to be destroyed while a visitor was actively visiting them.
Fixed balance issues related to overall game difficulty.
Fixed an issue that prevented grave and gravestone placement after loading a saved game.
Fixed Technician Employee going to trash without a trash bag.
Crematorium ovens now show a burning indicator if you’re holding a corpse.
Various Input System updates for better controller detection.
Fixed bug where a corpse could disappear when trying to take it back from the furnace.
Fixed Gardener Employee leaving the farm area to grab items from storage unnecessarily.
Thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!

items.text: Hi Gravediggers, 🧟‍♂️

notes.title: Here’s what’s included in this update

items.text: The Chapel interior has been updated to feel more atmospheric, it’s no longer just a room with benches. Something new might be waiting here soon…

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/f1b0cb9b94eb13f25d39e9e9e6e50834dabcef11.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/2c8811909266b9d61024e11157861adb5d6b546e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/120cb81d9329a4d2b3facf3b5b7355e7a81df0db.png"]
Completely overhauled pathfinding system for both Employees and Visitors. Movements are now smoother, more natural, and less prone to getting stuck (we hope!)
Employees and Visitors can now vault over fences just like the player
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/edefd1435005d791e8bb594caac0907affd752fe.gif"]
Florist Employee will now restock stands when no visitors are waiting
Added the ability to pause Employees without firing them, useful if you want them to just stand by
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/3244b0ff9c5117a39d490d6e0e4ddceaf00b84a7.gif"]
You can now sell unwanted items in the Dark Market at half price by switching to Selling Mode
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/2c17084c0d8d05669c2e4e2ef6d0b7020ebdd446.png"]
Added Buy/Sell whole stack toggle to the Dark Market UI for faster transactions
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/1c7ed38ae72dfa086c836b9c0c50372988aef372.png"]
Rotten corpses no longer disappear instantly, they now turn into rotten bags and can be removed manually if you threw them into trash container
Added auto-scroll navigation to Inventory and Storage UI when using a controller
Fixed an issue where scrolling down in Inventory and Storage would not work as intended
Fixed a issue where some buildable objects could be duplicated
Fixed an issue causing Hulk and Armored zombies’ health to multiply incorrectly
Fixed a issue that blocked the Souvenir Shop Tutorial progress
Added an “I’m Stuck” button to Pause Menu for emergencies. If you get stuck, just press it!
Fixed a bug where gravestones and defense structures lost their cleanliness/durability after loading a save
Fixed a rare Storage lockup bug when picking up an item at the same time as the Gardener Employee
Balance changes for turrets
As always, thank you for the feedback, bug reports, and love you’ve been sending. We’re working hard to keep the graveyard running smoothly and more updates are already on the way.
Hi Gravediggers, 🧟‍♂️

We’re also working on a roadmap to give you a clearer view of what’s coming next and we’ll be sharing it soon!

notes.title: Here’s everything included in this patch

items.text: Added new zombie type: Hulk – a stronger and more aggressive zombie that uses a Charge attack when it spots you from a distance. If it hits you, it’s going to hurt.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/f4453c58ac7a6fcd4cb82f764c0ccb2652225d24.gif"]
Added vaulting you can now jump over fences using the Jump key
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/f08a758591de85ebebf05d329e3d827fa30ae99b.gif"]
You can now dig up filled graves using the shovel
You can now completely destroy graves with the hammer
You can now destroy Planter Boxes using the hammer
Added filter category options to the Storage UI (like the Inventory UI)
Fixed an issue where the Storage UI wouldn’t open properly
Technician employee's task priority has been updated, they now clean trash first, then repair defenses
Removed the Decay system from defense objects, it was causing confusion and unnecessary breakdowns
Fixed bug where corpses placed on the ground could fall through the terrain after loading a save
The dead tree at the edge of the map can now be removed
Removed grid smoothing for grave placement, you can now place graves more precisely and symmetrically
Fixed collider issue with the trash container interaction
Fixed an issue where employees could get stuck while cremating
Fixed a bug where carrying a corpse while an employee uses the furnace would break the held corpse
Fixed bug where corpses weren’t removed from the pickup vehicle after auto-pickup
Added new default zombie models
Updated zombie wave configurations, nights now feature more varied wave types and enemy counts
Fixed an issue where the Brush animation would play when collecting water while holding the Brush
Prevented employees from interrupting the player while working on graves
Prevented employees from interrupting the player while working on Planter Boxes
Minor game balance adjustments
General performance improvements
As always, thank you all for playing, reviewing, bug reporting, and helping us push this little graveyard forward.
Hi Gravediggers, 🧟‍♂️
We’re back with another update and this one brings something many of you have been asking for! Achievements!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/b59492716ceef542ed2ab5d00bc288f52a34bf2a.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/bc2169fb58d63ff80b010195ac1d3371b6428e88.png"]

Updated to a new version of AI Pathfinding, which should reduce path-related issues across the board
Fixed a bug where carrying a corpse while an employee was using the cremation furnace could cause the corpse in the player’s hands to break
Fixed a rare issue where employees could get stuck while trying to access the cremation furnace
